title: Signature Adaptive Contrast Ring
description: Signature Adaptive Contrast Ring is a interface ability in the Signature Dynamic Focus Rings database. Picks a ring color that contrasts with whatever is behind it. The pixels under the ring are sampled and the ring color is chosen for maximum contrast. It takes background pixels and produces contrasting ring. Tunable parameters: WCAG AA. Guarantee: the ring is never invisible. This record is a Signature-authored completion — an original design of the JAH system, clearly labeled Signature, and not presented as a harvested public record.

fields.mechanism: The pixels under the ring are sampled and the ring color is chosen for maximum contrast.

title: Signature Group Focus Halo
